pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed dark brown regions with jagged, high-frequency edge oscillations. Patch geometry is non-uniform, with larger polygons on the upper neck transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the lower shoulder region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a complex topological graph. Clear junction nodes are visible where three or more pathways intersect. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and uniform across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a continuous, high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background. Individual hair tufts create a jagged 1D contour along the upper neck.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent vertical linear depression or skin fold is visible at the junction of the lower neck and shoulder, creating a deep shadow that vertically bisects several pelage patches.
